scope: Historical market data, token analytics and execution services
method: Official docs/product pages reviewed where available. API details and commercial access vary; findings are research notes, not a verified service integration.

discoveries: Solana datasets are organized into schemas such as core, DeFi, price and stats.
Documentation publishes schema and data freshness information separately.
patterns: Use curated schemas for historical cohort studies and aggregate validation.
Record schema version, refresh lag and query snapshot.
overlap: External analytics source only; not live canonical ingress.
risks: Schema/freshness differences affect label timing.
Commercial/API access and data rights require review.
validation: Inspect schema definitions and freshness page.
Cross-check sampled transactions and aggregates against canonical chain data.

provenance: Official Hello Moon site entry; product/API contract not fully verified in this review.
discoveries: Listed as Solana analytics/data provider.
Current dataset scope, latency and endpoint availability require direct documentation review.
patterns: Require per-field provenance, timestamps, and missingness for imported features.
Treat wallet metrics as research labels until reconciled.
overlap: Potential historical source; no runtime overlap confirmed.
risks: Coverage, semantics, cost and license/data rights unverified.
Derived PnL may omit transfers or unrealized exposure.
validation: Acquire docs and sample data under authorized access.
Reconcile wallets with confirmed transaction histories and known cases.

provenance: Official Moralis Solana API help and OpenAPI docs; accessed 2026-10-14.
discoveries: Solana data API includes wallet, token, NFT, price and DeFi data endpoints.
Endpoint costs/credits vary by API method.
patterns: Wrap API fields in provider-specific adapters with quota and freshness metadata.
Use cross-provider reconciliation for critical balances and fills.
overlap: Parsed data source potentially overlaps current provider ingestion; use only with explicit adapter need.
risks: Rate limits and endpoint costs vary.
Provider parsing is not canonical proof.
validation: Check current OpenAPI contract and endpoint pricing.
Compare samples against Solana RPC and on-chain transaction records.

provenance: Official CoinStats public API specification; accessed 2026-10-14.
discoveries: Public API provides market data, charts, wallets, exchange connections and portfolio endpoints.
API requires X-API-KEY or OAuth bearer credentials.
patterns: Use portfolio tooling only as a reconciliation comparison, not ledger authority.
Keep API credentials scoped and out of logs.
overlap: User-facing portfolio analytics may complement internal ledger review; no execution integration.
risks: Third-party portfolio tracking may omit unsupported transfers/fees.
Credential exposure and plan limits.
validation: Compare positions against confirmed wallet balances and execution receipts.
Verify endpoint scope, quotas and terms before integration.

discoveries: API provides current and historical coin/token market data and on-chain-related products.
Asset coverage and API products differ by endpoint and plan.
patterns: Use broad market context and historical archives as secondary research inputs.
Store asset ID/mint mapping and source timestamp explicitly.
overlap: Aggregated market data complements DEX-level local observations but is not executable quote evidence.
risks: Coverage may omit newly launched meme tokens or have sampling/refresh delays.
Symbol mapping ambiguity and plan limits.
validation: Match by mint/contract, not symbol alone.
Check API freshness, history granularity and missing observations.

provenance: Official DefiLlama website and API docs; accessed 2026-10-14.
discoveries: DefiLlama publishes protocol, chain, fee, TVL and DEX-activity datasets through site/API products.
Aggregates are ecosystem-level measures and do not establish token-specific executable liquidity.
patterns: Use broad market regime metrics as contextual covariates.
Keep chain/protocol aggregates distinct from token/pool measurements.
overlap: Complementary context only; no execution-path overlap.
risks: Methodology and protocol coverage vary by dataset.
Aggregated TVL/volume can be delayed or incomplete.
validation: Inspect API definitions and update cadence.
Compare a sample against protocol-level source data.

provenance: Official DEX Screener API reference; accessed 2026-10-14.
discoveries: API includes pair search, pair lookup and token-pair endpoints with documented rate limits.
Pair output includes pool identifiers, prices, transactions, volume and liquidity fields.
patterns: Normalize pool address and mint identity; never join on ticker alone.
Respect API limits and timestamp every market snapshot.
overlap: Secondary market snapshot source; execution still needs route-specific fresh quotes.
risks: Snapshot values may be stale and differ from executable price.
Rate limits and undocumented edge cases.
validation: Compare pair data against on-chain pool state and executable quote.
Test 429, missing-pair and multiple-pool cases.

provenance: Official RugCheck website entry; public API schema not fully verified here.
discoveries: Service provides token-risk reports for Solana assets.
A scanner score is a derived summary and cannot prove sellability or future safety.
patterns: Preserve report timestamp, mint and individual findings rather than only a score.
Combine structural checks with holder, liquidity and test-sell verification.
overlap: Potential advisory risk input, not a standalone decision authority.
risks: Detection coverage/false negatives and report freshness.
API access and terms unverified.
validation: Verify current API docs and test known benign/risky fixtures.
Check findings against mint authorities, pool state and direct chain data.

provenance: Official Bubblemaps website entry; dataset/API details not fully reviewed.
discoveries: Product visualizes token holder relationships and concentration clusters.
Relationship inference should be distinguished from direct ownership proof.
patterns: Use cluster analysis to prioritize manual wallet-flow investigation.
Retain the underlying link evidence and uncertainty.
overlap: Analyst aid; no direct execution authority.
risks: False clustering can misattribute common control.
Snapshot timing and token coverage can omit transfers.
validation: Verify graph evidence against transaction history.
Test with known synthetic transfer graphs and time-bounded snapshots.

provenance: Official Birdeye website/API docs entry; specific endpoint contracts require current review.
discoveries: Market data product covers Solana token/pool analytics and API access.
Endpoint coverage, latency, plans and historical depth vary.
patterns: Use as a secondary price/trade observation with provider timestamp and pool identity.
Measure missingness and freshness at token-launch times.
overlap: Potential market data feed; retain existing canonical/quote boundaries.
risks: Provider-derived prices may not equal executable route output.
Quota and plan terms may change.
validation: Compare selected mint/pool snapshots to DEX and on-chain observations.
Test rate limits, pagination and stale data detection.

discoveries: Explorer provides human-readable Solana transaction/account/token inspection.
Explorer rendering is a convenience view over chain data, not an API contract or authoritative accounting ledger.
patterns: Use explorer links for human verification of signatures and account state.
Retain raw signature/mint identifiers for reproducible evidence.
overlap: Manual verification surface only; not a runtime data dependency.
risks: UI indexing delay, interpretation or cluster selection errors.
Explorer availability is not equivalent to chain confirmation.
validation: Verify cluster and raw transaction status through canonical RPC.
Compare parsed amounts with token decimals and balance deltas.

discoveries: Query parameter selects a non-default cluster context labeled mainnet-alpha.
Cluster context can materially change the meaning of displayed accounts/transactions.
patterns: Store cluster/genesis identity with every explorer link and observation.
Reject cross-cluster joins unless explicitly intended.
risks: Misreading mainnet-alpha as mainnet can contaminate validation.
UI context may be changed by navigation/session state.
validation: Verify cluster genesis hash via RPC before interpreting evidence.
Include explicit cluster in screenshots and reports.

provenance: Official DFlow product/docs entry; current API semantics require version-specific review.
discoveries: DFlow offers Solana order routing/execution products and API integration.
Quote and execution workflows need to distinguish quote validity, transaction construction and landing.
patterns: Compare route quote against executable net output and simulate before signing.
Record route/provider, quote timestamp, expiry and realized fill.
overlap: Potential routing adapter, not a new execution authority.
risks: API/provider changes, route fees and transaction semantics.
No route quote guarantees confirmation or final received amount.
validation: Use documented API versions and local/test transactions.
Reconcile confirmed balances and all fees against quote.

provenance: Titan Exchange website entry; developer/API capabilities not independently verified in this review.
discoveries: Listed as Solana swap/trading infrastructure.
Current API, supported venues, order semantics and availability require primary documentation review.
patterns: Require route-level quote, simulation, fee and fill evidence before adapter evaluation.
Keep provider routing behind existing authority controls.
overlap: Possible execution route provider; overlaps swap routing only.
risks: API/plan and endpoint contracts unverified.
Execution quality cannot be inferred from marketing description.
validation: Obtain current official API docs and testnet/simulation fixtures.
Compare landed outcomes and total costs with baseline router.

discoveries: Trader API documentation advertises Solana transaction landing services and data streams.
Docs list supported DEX options and require account tier for access.
patterns: Measure transport delivery and chain confirmation separately.
Track tip/priority/route expenses and actual landing outcome per attempt.
overlap: Potential transport/provider adapter; existing signing authority remains separate.
risks: Provider performance claims and endpoint availability require measured validation.
Paid tier and transaction costs may affect net profitability.
validation: Verify current Solana API/auth/fee docs.
Use authorized non-capital tests and compare landed slot, expiry and total cost.
